北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阳光正好，体感 11℃ 稍凉，记得适时添衣，多喝水哦。
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny but feels cool. Remember to layer up and stay hydrated!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阳光明媚，体感舒适。昼夜温差大，早晚注意保暖。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is sunny and pleasant. Mind the temperature swing between day and night.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阳光正好，体感 14℃ 微凉，早晚温差大，外出记得添衣。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is sunny but feels cool. The temperature difference is big, layer up when out.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州天气晴朗，气温 24℃ 舒适。阳光正好，注意防晒补水哦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and comfortable. Enjoy the sunshine, but remember sun protection and hydration.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，气温 24℃ 舒适。记得多喝水，保持好心情哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy and comfortable. Remember to drink water and stay cheerful!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阳光正好，风力 3级 较大，体感 12℃ 偏凉，记得穿暖和点。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is sunny and windy, feels quite cool. Remember to dress warmly.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阳光明媚，风力 3级 不小，体感 12℃ 偏凉，外出注意保暖！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny with some wind, feels cool. Remember to dress warmly when out!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阳光正好，气温 21℃ 舒适，适合户外活动。记得多喝水。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is sunny and comfortable, perfect for outdoor activities. Remember to drink water.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阳光正好，体感 13℃ 微凉，早晚温差大，出门注意保暖。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is sunny but feels a bit cool. Big temperature swings, remember to dress warmly.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阳光充足，气温舒适，但湿度 3% 很低，记得多补水润肤哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and pleasant, but very dry. Remember to hydrate and moisturize!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云，气温 20℃ 舒适，湿度适中，出门心情美美哒！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and comfortable with moderate humidity. Enjoy your day out!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨多云，气温 7℃ 很低，风力 3级 不小，务必穿厚实保暖。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy and very cold with some wind. Please dress warmly and bundle up!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云，风力 4级 大体感冷，外出注意防风保暖，多喝水。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy, windy, and feels cold. Protect from wind, stay warm, and hydrate.
沈阳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阳光明媚，体感 16℃ 微凉，风力 3级 稍大，早晚记得添衣。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny but feels a bit cool with some wind. Remember to layer up in the mornings and evenings.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，气温 21℃ 宜人，舒适度高。记得保持好心情哦！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy with pleasant, comfortable temperatures. Keep up the good mood!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阳光正好，体感 5℃ 偏冷，风力 3级 不小，注意防风保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is sunny but feels quite cold and windy. Please remember to dress warmly and protect from wind.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 6℃ 偏冷，风力 3级 不小，外出请穿厚实保暖。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and feels quite cold and windy. Please dress warmly when going out.
